sources.label: Wikipedia, "LTT 9779"
sources.quote: LTT 9779, also named Uúba, is a G-type main-sequence star located 264 light-years away from the Solar System in the constellation of Sculptor.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Jenkins et al. 2020.

sources.label: Jenkins et al. (2020), Nature Astronomy 4 1148-1157

sources.label: Wikipedia, "LTT 9779"
sources.quote: The star is about 95% the radius and about the same mass as the Sun, but younger than the Sun at 1.7 billion years old, hence its lower luminosity.
